Flat pure #00FF00 green background. Rhukk is full body, centered, his proportions exactly those of the supplied image in every frame. He has exactly four clawed arms, two legs and one great curved horn. The horn grows from his face and stays rigidly attached to his head; it never moves independently. The raised claw above his head is the hand of his upper arm, not a horn. Each arm is a separate jointed limb attached to a shoulder, with an elbow and clawed hand. He stays in the exact same front three-quarter view as the image the whole clip: his horn always points to image-right, his red eyes always face the viewer, his shell stays behind him. He never rotates, never turns toward or away from the camera and never turns his back. He walks with a steady, heavy treadmill gait, staying centered at the same size. Each foot lifts, passes the other foot beneath his body and plants ahead along the direction his horn already points; the planted foot slides back beneath his hips as the other foot takes its turn. He takes four evenly spaced steps over ten seconds. With every step his weight flows onto the supporting leg, his bent knees absorb the weight, his upper body sways naturally and his shell rises and falls a little. His whole upper body moves naturally with every step: shoulders and hips sway, all four arms swing loosely opposite his legs, his ragged cloth follows the movement. The upper arm with the raised claw bends at its elbow and swings from its shoulder beside his body with the gait, separate from his head and horn. The horn, face and shell keep their opening angle throughout this walking cycle. All in one fluid motion with no pause. Same body and colours throughout. The background is matte and casts no light on him. Locked-off static camera, no zoom, no pan. He settles into exactly his opening stance on the final frame.
